SELECT

  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_warehouse w ON f.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY w.city
ORDER BY w.city

    w.region_name AS 大区,
    SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound f

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 'Q3' THEN f.outbound_amount ELSE 0 END) AS q3_outbound_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 'Q4' THEN f.outbound_amount ELSE 0 END) AS q4_outbound_amount
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN ('Q3', 'Q4')

SELECT 
  dc.cargo_category AS 品类,
  SUM(fo.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_warehouse dw ON fo.warehouse_id = dw.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 
  AND dw.region_name = '华北'

SELECT 
  t1.cargo_category AS 品类,
  t1.cargo_brand AS 品牌,
  t1.outbound_amount_sum AS 出库货值
FROM (
  SELECT 
    d.cargo_category,
    d.cargo_brand,
    SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS outbound_amount_sum,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.cargo_category ORDER BY SUM(f.outbound_amount) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_outbound f
  JOIN dim_cargo d ON f.cargo_id = d.cargo_id
  JOIN dim_date dt ON f.date_id = dt.date_id
  WHERE dt.year = 2025
  GROUP BY d.cargo_category, d.cargo_brand
) t1
WHERE t1.rn = 1

JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, c.cargo_brand
ORDER BY d.year, d.quarter, c.cargo_brand

FROM fact_outbound t1

SELECT 
  ds.shipper_level AS `客户等级`,
  AVG(fo.outbound_amount) AS `平均单笔出库货值`

JOIN dim_shipper ds ON fo.shipper_id = ds.shipper_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY ds.shipper_level

SELECT 
  d.month,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS current_month_amount,
  LAG(SUM(f.outbound_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.month) AS prev_month_amount,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(f.outbound_amount) - LAG(SUM(f.outbound_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.month)) / 
    NULLIF(LAG(SUM(f.outbound_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.month), 0) * 100, 2
  ) AS month_over_month_growth_percent
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.month
ORDER BY d.month

SELECT 
  dc.cargo_brand AS 品牌,
  SUM(fo.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值,
  ROUND(SUM(fo.outbound_amount) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(outbound_amount) FROM fact_outbound fo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON fo2.date_id = dd2.date_id WHERE dd2.year = 2025), 2) AS 占比
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dc.cargo_brand
ORDER BY 出库货值 DESC

JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.date_id BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20251231
GROUP BY dc.cargo_brand

SELECT dc.cargo_category
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dc.cargo_category
HAVING SUM(fo.outbound_amount) > 1000000

SELECT 
  d.quarter,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS outbound_amount
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN ('Q3', 'Q4')
GROUP BY d.quarter
ORDER BY d.quarter

SELECT 
  dc.cargo_category AS 品类,
  SUM(fo.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_warehouse dw ON fo.warehouse_id = dw.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 
  AND dw.region_name = '华北'
GROUP BY dc.cargo_category

SELECT 
  t1.cargo_category AS 品类,
  t1.cargo_brand AS 品牌,
  t1.total_amount AS 出库货值
FROM (
  SELECT 
    dc.cargo_category,
    dc.cargo_brand,
    SUM(fo.outbound_amount) AS total_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.cargo_category ORDER BY SUM(fo.outbound_amount) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_outbound fo
  JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
  WHERE dd.year = 2025
  GROUP BY dc.cargo_category, dc.cargo_brand
) t1
WHERE t1.rn = 1

SELECT 
  d.year AS 年,
  d.quarter AS 季度,
  c.cargo_brand AS 品牌,
  SUM(f.outbound_quantity) AS 出库件数
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
JOIN dim_cargo c ON f.cargo_id = c.cargo_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, c.cargo_brand
ORDER BY d.year, d.quarter, c.cargo_brand

SELECT 
  w.region_name AS 大区,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_shipper s ON f.shipper_id = s.shipper_id
JOIN dim_warehouse w ON f.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE s.shipper_level = '战略' 
  AND d.year = 2025
GROUP BY w.region_name

SELECT t1.cargo_category, SUM(t2.outbound_quantity) AS outbound_quantity
FROM dim_cargo t1
JOIN fact_outbound t2 ON t1.cargo_id = t2.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date t3 ON t2.date_id = t3.date_id
WHERE t3.year = 2025
GROUP BY t1.cargo_category
ORDER BY SUM(t2.outbound_amount) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT SUM(t1.outbound_amount) AS outbound_amount
FROM fact_outbound t1
JOIN dim_warehouse t2 ON t1.warehouse_id = t2.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_cargo t3 ON t1.cargo_id = t3.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date t4 ON t1.date_id = t4.date_id
WHERE t2.region_name = '华北'
  AND t2.warehouse_type = '中心仓'
  AND t3.cargo_category = '3C数码'
  AND t4.year = 2025

SELECT ds.shipper_level AS 客户等级, AVG(fo.outbound_amount) AS 平均单笔出库货值
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_shipper ds ON fo.shipper_id = ds.shipper_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY ds.shipper_level

SELECT 
  d.month AS 月,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) - LAG(SUM(f.outbound_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month) AS 比上月增长
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month

SELECT 
  dc.cargo_brand AS 品牌,
  SUM(fo.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值,
  ROUND(SUM(fo.outbound_amount) / (SELECT SUM(outbound_amount) FROM fact_outbound fo2 JOIN dim_date dd2 ON fo2.date_id = dd2.date_id WHERE dd2.year = 2025) * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dc.cargo_brand
ORDER BY 出库货值 DESC

SELECT 
  dw.city AS 城市,
  SUM(fo.outbound_amount) / COUNT(*) AS 单均出库货值
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_warehouse dw ON fo.warehouse_id = dw.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dw.city

SELECT d.shipper_name
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_shipper d ON f.shipper_id = d.shipper_id
JOIN dim_date dt ON f.date_id = dt.date_id
WHERE dt.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.shipper_name
ORDER BY SUM(f.outbound_quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    dw.region_name AS 大区,
    ds.shipper_level AS 客户等级,
    COUNT(*) AS 出库单量
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_shipper ds ON fo.shipper_id = ds.shipper_id
JOIN dim_warehouse dw ON fo.warehouse_id = dw.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dw.region_name, ds.shipper_level
ORDER BY dw.region_name, ds.shipper_level

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.shipper_id) 
FROM fact_outbound fo 
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id 
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id 
WHERE dc.cargo_category = '生鲜冷链' 
  AND dd.year = 2025

SELECT 
  d.year AS 年,
  d.month AS 月,
  SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month

SELECT 
    w.city AS 城市,
    SUM(f.outbound_quantity) AS 出库件数
FROM fact_outbound f
JOIN dim_cargo c ON f.cargo_id = c.cargo_id
JOIN dim_warehouse w ON f.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE c.cargo_category = '家用电器'
    AND d.year = 2025
GROUP BY w.city

SELECT dc.cargo_brand
FROM fact_outbound fo
JOIN dim_cargo dc ON fo.cargo_id = dc.cargo_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dc.cargo_brand
ORDER BY SUM(fo.outbound_amount) / COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
